summary.note: Adoption of the P1 projection input is verified when every leg passes: the wired engine reproduces the measured arm on the production path. SP compression (~0.38 sextile ratio) stays capped — the binary moneyline owns SP-mismatch pricing; P2 remains unadopted (RE_TEST_CANDIDATE, 7e4c529).

measured_arm.arm_definition: C0 side view (53 features: derive_run_features keep list + RUN_LEVEL_ENV present) + one appended column per side: sp_proj_era_<opp> — the OPPOSING starter's projection level. sp_era_diff stays in the shared env (the arm ADDED the level; it did NOT swap the gap). raw opponent ERA level NOT added (that is P2, unadopted).

run_engine.py: build_side_frame: appends sp_proj_era_<opp> to each side's column list WHEN the frame carries the column (absent -> byte-identical pre-adoption view).

attach_projection_levels (new): the P1 seam — fits z-mu/sd + ERA~composite OLS on the decided pre-holdout rows (dates < max - 21d, the alpha/k convention) via sp_projection.fit_projection_stats, applies via apply_projection_stats to decided AND slate (slate never fit on itself). Degrades to legacy view with a loud log when components are absent (cold-start/synthetic) or the pre pool is too thin — never takes down Phase 3.
run_engine_daily: enriches decided + target_games BEFORE the OOF walk and slate pricing (production entry point).
run_engine_k_edge.py: daily fallback (cache-empty k fit) enriches decided the same way so k is fit on the SAME P1 lambda basis the markets are priced on.
sp_projection.py: ADDITIVE fit/apply split (fit_projection_stats / apply_projection_stats / projection_components_present). attach_projection_cols is byte-identical (producer pins -1.2213/-1.2138 slopes, coverage 0.9736/0.9742/0.9866/0.9933 reproduced bit-for-bit).
production_wiring.unchanged: model family/hyperparameters (RUN_LGBM_PARAMS), C2 k-edge pricing, NB/alpha machinery, MARGIN_PLUS1_HOME_SHARE 0.744 tie term, served FEATURE_COLS (binary untouched), artifact schema (run_engine_markets_*.csv / meta / monitor).

scope_notes: SP compression stays capped (~0.38 sextile ratio, context only) — the binary moneyline owns SP-mismatch pricing by routing.
P2 (projection + raw ERA) remains unadopted (RE_TEST_CANDIDATE, structural near-miss per 7e4c529).

run_margin_diff (the moneyline's lambda-edge feature) stays on the legacy C0 lambda basis — the binary's served feature set is off-limits and its calibration absorbs its own inputs; only run-engine markets pricing changes.

The projection z-stats/OLS scale are refit per daily run on the then-current pre-holdout pool (the measured arm's discipline); day-over-day drift of the global scale is inherent to the accepted producer and should be drift-monitored like the restored diff features.
